split.sub: Cut a big plan into parts

build -> commit.note: each slice and the review fixes

build -> review.note: after the slices, for a build of the plan

refactor -> plan.note: one plan per group of picks

refactor -> tidy.note: its six checks, on the whole area

refactor -> markup-a11y-reviewer.when: the area holds markup and no stack plugin reviews its accessibility

refactor -> mochi-python:conventions-rev.when: the area is a FastAPI service

refactor -> mochi-python:api-contract-re.when: the area is a FastAPI service with an HTTP surface

review -> quick-reviewer.when: an area is under 80 lines and reaches no trust boundary

review -> correctness-reviewer.when: an area is not small, or the user asks for a full review

review -> test-reviewer.when: an area is not small, or the user asks for a full review

review -> hygiene-reviewer.when: an area is not small, or the user asks for a full review; scoped when the tidy skill already ran

review -> markup-a11y-reviewer.when: an area changes markup and no stack plugin reviews its accessibility

review -> mochi-python:conventions-revie.when: an area is a FastAPI service

review -> mochi-python:api-contract-revi.when: an area is a FastAPI service and touches its HTTP surface

review -> commit.when: a fix belongs to the unmerged part below, outside a build

review -> pr.note: its stack check, and the push of a fix on the part below

plan -> bar-raiser.note: once, plus one re-check by the same agent

mochi-react:inject-matching-skills -> @m.note: injects each one, up front or when its paths match

mochi-python:inject-matching-skills -> @.note: injects each one, up front or when its paths match

split -> plan.note: its plan format, challenge, and view
